name: n8n
tagline: Source-available workflow automation with native AI-agent nodes, self-hostable and integration-rich.
verdict: n8n is the strongest choice for teams that want agentic automation built visually rather than in code, without giving up the integration breadth or self-hosting control that no-code tools usually sacrifice. Its 400+ app integrations plus native AI-agent nodes mean an agent can actually go do something, call an API, update a CRM, post to Slack, not just answer a question. It is fair-code, not OSI open-source, so check the licence before reselling a self-hosted deployment commercially, and deeply branching agent logic can get harder to read on a canvas than in code. It suits ops-style automation with an agent in the loop best; developers who prefer expressing control flow purely as code may find LangGraph or CrewAI a better fit.
